applyTo: "README.md,CONTRIBUTING.md,CLAUDE.md,.claude/**/*.md,.github/copilot-instructions.md,.github/instructions/**/*.md,docs/**/*.md,wiki/**/*.md,**/locales/*.yaml,**/locales/*.yml,**/locales/*.json"
---

# Human Text Quality

- Write Markdown, process documentation, and agent-facing prose in English unless the file is a locale asset.
- In locale files, every message must be grammatical, natural, and idiomatic for that locale.
- Keep terminology, capitalization, and product naming consistent across sibling docs and locale files.
- Do not mix languages inside one sentence, heading, or locale value unless the text is a code identifier or product name.
- When editing template or placeholder prose, keep the examples grammatical in the language they are written in.
